business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- "Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Railways"; the deck's journey timeline runs 1976 (established under the Companies Act), 1992 (converted into Public Limited Company), 1998 (granted "Miniratna" status), 2006 (Schedule "A" Company), 2018 (equity shares listed on NSE & BSE), 2020 (achieved turnover of Rs.5,000 crore), 2023 (turnover crossed Rs.10,000 crore), 2023 (upgraded to "Navratna" Company) and 2024 (highest ever turnover achieved).
- Track record cited as 408 Domestic and 131 International under "Projects Completed", alongside executed work of 5,858 TKM railway track, 10,762 RKM railway electrification, 7,258 KMS roads and highways, 1.59 Mn Sqm buildings, 167 KMS tunnel and 183 Nos. bridges.
- Under "KEY ACHIEVEMENTS" the deck lists "USA ENR Construction Companies (Top International Contracting Firms for Year 2025)" and "Fortune India 500 (Dec 2025)" together with the ranks "239th" and "242nd"; the extraction does not preserve which rank belongs to which list, so the pairing is not asserted here.
- Group structure comprises 11 subsidiaries and 7 JVs, spanning wholly-owned road SPVs (HAM and BOT) and 26%-held rail connectivity JVs for coal and iron ore evacuation.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Sector tailwind] The deck's Opportunities slide cites a "Massive Govt. push to the CAPEX by allocation of Rs.12.2 lakh Crore in Union Budget 2026", an outlay of INR 2.78 lakh crore for Indian Railways and INR 3.10 lakh crore for road transport and highways.
- [Sector tailwind] It also cites that "Indian Railways to require investment of Rs.35.3 trillion (US$ 545.26 billion) by 2032 for capacity addition and modernization" and development of 08 National High Speed Corridor projects of 936 km length costing Rs.50,655 crore.
- [Policy] Named demand drivers include the National Logistic Policy, Logistic Parks and Unified Logistics Interface Platform, 100 PM Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals, the National Rail Plan, National Infrastructure Prioritization and the National Monetization Pipeline.
- [Board] Chairman & Managing Director Shri Saleem Ahmad holds the post on "Additional Charge" and is concurrently CMD of Rail Vikas Nigam Limited.

deepdive.thesis: IRCON International Ltd has received a credit rating of IVR AAA with a stable outlook from Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited, indicating a strong financial position and low credit risk. The company's bank facilities have been rated as IVR AAA with a stable outlook, reflecting its ability to meet its financial obligations. The rating rationale is based on the company's strong project execution capabilities and its position in the infrastructure sector.

themes.title: Railway rolling-stock & component capex
themes.need: A ~INR2.65 lakh cr Railways capital outlay and a pending ~1-lakh-wagon tender ('anytime this year' per JWL) drive rolling-stock, wheelsets, springs, castings, bogie components and interiors - with deep import-substitution (Neetu Yoshi 544434 castings; Airfloa 544516 interiors; Concord 543619 electronics). TITAGARH/TEXRAIL/JWL lead wagons; RVNL/IRCON/GPTINFRA on rail EPC.
themes.driver: Indian Railways large wagon tender award (next 1-2 quarters); wheelset plant ramp; Vande Bharat / Kavach orders.

themes.title: Infrastructure EPC & roads order-book conversion
themes.need: India's record capital-outlay cycle (roads, metro, marine, hydro, tunnelling) gives diversified EPC contractors multi-year visibility - AFCONS tracks a ~INR4 lakh cr pipeline (70% domestic) and targets ~INR30,000cr FY27 inflow; NCC/DBL/PNCINFRA/GRINFRA/ASHOKA/CEIGALL carry large road/HAM books; AFCONS/PATELENG/AHLUCONT/PSPPROJECT add marine, hydro and building EPC. The binding issue is execution + client-payment cycles, not order intake.
themes.driver: L1-to-firm-order conversion (AFCONS Croatia/Vadhavan, DMRC awards); NHAI/HAM award pickup; monsoon-end execution ramp.
